text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
We're here! Phew,
the air is so fresh! The 
forest is the absolute best!

After our outing, the two of us came to 
visit a cottage deep in the forest.
choice_data_list: Looks like this'll be a nice chang...
This seems like it'll be a nice ch...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Ah, over there. Looks like 
there are other customers too!
choice_data_list: Looks like this will be a good cha...
Looks like this will be a good cha...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! That's awesome! You went to all 
those places as a couple!?

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, yeah. Though that goes for 
you, too. It feels like a true 
three-legged race.

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, we totally got caught up 
talking. It's already dark outside."
choice_data_list: Ah, shall we wrap things up soon?

text_block_list.text: (Bzzzzzzt!)
choice_data_list: Yeah, should we call it a day soon?

text_block_list.text:
Just then, the cottage phone suddenly 
rang— and went dead midway through.
choice_data_list: ...Wrong number?

text_block_list.text: (Click—)
choice_data_list: ...A wrong number?

text_block_list.text: (Flap flap flap, caw, caw, caw)
choice_data_list: A blackout?!

text_block_list.text:
The lights come back on. In the suddenly 
hushed room, someone gasped.
choice_data_list: I wonder what that was all about...

text_block_list.name: Young Man
text_block_list.text:
The call... has gone dead. Just who was 
that...?
choice_data_list: I wonder what that was about...

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, don't say weird things like 
that! What do you mean, 'who'...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...A suspicious phone call, a blackout, 
and crows flying off eerily. A group that 
just happened to gather, effectively 
trapped on an isolated island—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Tonight... an incident might occur...!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
Tch, what nonsense. You read way too much 
manga. I'm going back to my room.
choice_data_list: Wait...?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Stooop!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In situations like this, the one who goes 
off alone always gets taken out first! 
Splitting up is strictly forbidden!
choice_data_list: Indeed, it's dangerous until we un...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text: E-Even if you say that, though...
choice_data_list: Indeed, it's dangerous until we un...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
There's a standard method for 
situations like this. Let's shut down 
every single possibility one by one!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I don't know who is plotting what, but I 
won't let it happen!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "On my grandma's name!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! First, let's block all entry 
points! The attic, the windows, under the 
floorboards! Oh, and check behind picture 
frames too!

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text:
Wait, under the floor... Wait, it's 
creaking right here! Could it really 
be...!?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Nice call! It's a relief we were able to 
find it here!
choice_data_list: Just in case, should we put someth...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If entry from the outside and escape 
routes after the incident are completely 
blocked, the culprit won't be able to 
carry out their crime!
choice_data_list: Just in case, should we put someth...

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text: ...Is this for real? Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what am I supposed to do? Tell me 
what I can help with.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! Thank you very much!
As for the rest, 
let's see...—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If we sneak in from under the floor like 
earlier... Away from prying eyes, it must 
be around here! There's probably an 
elaborate trick to it!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Be careful not to trigger anything by 
mistake! Watch out for tripwires, hidden 
buttons, and narrow gaps! And also—
choice_data_list: Like the dolls and figurines on di...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...! That's it, Trainer! All right! Let's 
check out every single suspicious spot!
choice_data_list: Like the dolls and figurines on di...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... Everyone is here, right?

text_block_list.name: Young Woman
text_block_list.text: Yeah, everyone's here! Nothing happened!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Man
text_block_list.text: Heheh, man, I worked up a great sweat...!
choice_data_list: Indeed!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... Ah, was everyone okay during 
the blackout? Sorry,
I was checking on the 
trouble and got completely delayed...
choice_data_list: Right!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Owner-san, you're safe...!

text_block_list.name: Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Well, it was crows. Pieces of metal 
got mixed into a crow's nest and touched 
the power lines, causing a massive 
blackout.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: ...The calls cutting off midway, t...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Because of crows... So the culprit was a 
crow?
choice_data_list: ...The phone cutting out and the b...

text_block_list.text:
...Everyone instantly deflated. It seemed 
there was never a culprit to begin with...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: A-Ahahahaha... Ehe.
choice_data_list: (...Still, maybe it was a little fun.)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer... The culprit wasn't there, 
but...
choice_data_list: (...Still, that was kind of fun, m...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "...Ummm."
choice_data_list: I had fun!
...That must've been rough, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...! Right? Isn't it?!
choice_data_list: It was a lot of fun!
...That must've been rough, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My heart started racing all at once,
and I 
got so nervous! Seeing you investigate 
everything so efficiently, Trainer, you 
were so cool and reliable!
choice_data_list: You're praising me way too much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, but still! It was just... so much 
fun!
choice_data_list: You're praising me way too much!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh? Come on! You were totally getting 
into it, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's what I'd like to think, 
anyway. Because, it was just... so much 
fun!
